product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Food jams constantly - very frustrating. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary automatic feeder about six weeks ago and I'm already at my wit's end with it. The kibble jams in the dispensing mechanism at least once every couple of days, meaning my two cats go without food until I notice. I work long hours so the whole point was peace of mind while I'm away. The jam issue completely defeats the purpose. Customer service did respond quickly and suggested I try smaller kibble, which helped slightly, but it still happens. The capacity is generous and the LCD screen is easy enough to read, but if it can't reliably dispense food, what's the point? Wouldn't recommend for anyone leaving their pets for extended periods

product_name: PETLIBRO Air Automatic Cat Feeder WiFi
text: Absolute lifesaver for early mornings. Been using the PETLIBRO air automatic feeder for four months now and it's been brilliant. My cat Biscuit used to wake me up at 5am without fail but since programming the first meal for 6:30am she's stopped bothering me entirely. Setup took about ten minutes and the app is surprisingly intuitive. Highly recommend

product_name: Cat Mate Elite Super Feeder WiFi
text: WiFi drops every single day. I really wanted to love this but the WiFi connectivity on the Cat Mate Elite Super Feeder is absolutely abysmal. It disconnects from my network daily, sometimes multiple times a day, and I have to physically reset the unit to get it back online. I have a strong mesh network throughout my house so it's definitely not a signal issue. Without the app connection I can't check if my cats have been fed or adjust portions remotely, which was the entire reason I bought a WiFi model over a cheaper timer-based one. Returned it after three weeks

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder WiFi 6L
text: Good feeder, app could be better. The PETLIBRO Granary works reliably and the portion sizes are reasonably accurate. My main gripe is with the app, which occasionally logs me out for no reason and sometimes takes ages to sync changes to the feeding schedule. The feeder itself seems to remember the schedule even when the app is being temperamental, which is reassuring. Build quality feels solid and it holds plenty of dry food. Knocked one star off purely for the app reliability

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with WiFi and Battery Backup
text: Battery backup is a complete lie. We had a power cut last month and discovered the hard way that the battery backup on our automatic feeder simply does not work. Put three fresh AA batteries in as instructed when we first set it up, but when the power went out the unit was completely dead. Cats went unfed for nearly eight hours. Tested the batteries afterwards and they were absolutely fine, so the backup circuitry must be faulty. For a product that markets itself on reliability and peace of mind, this is an unforgivable flaw. One star and straight back to Amazon

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Dry Cat Feeder 3L
text: Does the job but noisier than expected. It feeds the cats on schedule, which is the main thing. But the motor noise when it dispenses is surprisingly loud - it woke me up the first couple of nights because I'd put it in the kitchen near the bedroom wall. Moved it to the other end of the flat and it's less of an issue now. Portion accuracy seems fine for my cats' needs

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Three years and still going strong. I know you don't often see long-term reviews on Amazon but I felt compelled to write one. My Cat Mate C500 automatic feeder has been running without a single problem for over three years. Five meal compartments, easy to programme, the ice pack compartment keeps wet food fresh for morning feeds, and it cleans up brilliantly in the dishwasher. My elderly cat relies on small frequent meals due to kidney disease and this feeder has been an absolute godsend. If you want something reliable over the long term, go with Cat Mate. You pay a bit more but it's worth every penny

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Portions wildly inaccurate. The portion calibration on this feeder is nowhere near what the app claims. I set it to dispense 30g per meal and weighed the output several times - it ranged from 18g to 47g across different feeds. For a cat on a strict diet following veterinary advice, this level of inaccuracy is genuinely dangerous. I expected some variance but not this much. The PETLIBRO app is also quite clunky and slow to respond

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder Dual Outlet 6L
text: Really pleased overall. Set this up for our three cats and it's been working a treat for two months. Plenty of capacity in the 6L hopper and the dual outlet is great for feeding multiple cats without them squabbling over one bowl. Docking a star because cleaning the dispensing mechanism is quite fiddly - you can't really get it properly clean without a bottle brush and some patience. Worth it though

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder WiFi App Controlled 4L
text: App stopped working after update. Everything was fine for the first month. Then an app update completely broke the connection between the feeder and my phone. The feeder still runs on its stored schedule, thankfully, but I can no longer adjust anything, view feeding logs, or receive notifications. I've tried uninstalling and reinstalling, forgetting the device and re-pairing, and contacting support three times. Each time support sends me the same generic troubleshooting steps that don't work. This is now going on six weeks. Absolutely shocking customer support and I deeply regret not buying a Cat Mate instead

product_name: PETLIBRO Air Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Perfect for my anxious boy. My cat gets very anxious about food and used to pester us constantly. The PETLIBRO feeder has genuinely changed our home life. He now knows food comes at set times and has calmed down enormously. Easy to set up, quiet enough not to disturb him, and the recorded voice feature where you can call your cat to their meal is adorable. Brilliant product

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: Cleaning this is a proper nightmare. The feeder works well enough mechanically but I absolutely dread cleaning it. The hopper and the internal auger mechanism are not properly dishwasher safe despite what the listing implies, and hand washing requires disassembling multiple fiddly parts that are difficult to get back together correctly. I've had the unit misaligned twice after cleaning, causing the food to jam. For something you're supposed to clean weekly for hygiene, the design is really poorly thought through

product_name: Cat Mate C20 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: My cat figured out how to break into it. This is less a criticism of the feeder and more a testament to my cat's determination. He's managed to knock the lid off and help himself on three separate occasions. It's not designed to resist a very persistent and clever cat. Works well otherwise and the schedule function is straightforward

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: SureFeed is worth the extra money. We have three cats and one of them is on prescription food. The SureFeed microchip feeder has been an absolute revelation - it only opens for the cat whose chip it recognises, so the other two can't steal her expensive prescription kibble. Yes it's pricier than competitors but it solves a genuinely difficult problem. Solid build quality, easy to clean compared to other automatic feeders I've tried, and connects reliably to the Sure Petcare app

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with LCD Screen
text: Arrived broken. Motor made a grinding noise from the very first use and never dispensed a single portion properly. Returned immediately

product_name: Cat Mate Elite Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Good capacity, reliable schedule. The 6L hopper means I only need to top it up every week or so, which suits me perfectly. The programming is a bit old-fashioned with buttons rather than an app, but honestly that might be a feature rather than a bug - there's nothing to go wrong with WiFi or software updates. Been running for four months without a jam or missed meal. My only complaint is the bowl feels a bit light and cheap

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 3L
text: Dispensing noise woke my light sleeper. My partner is an extremely light sleeper and the feeder is scheduled for 6am. The motor on this thing is genuinely quite loud - a sort of whirring and clunking that carries through walls. We had to move it out of the kitchen entirely and into the utility room. Not ideal. The feeder functions correctly otherwise but I'd strongly advise anyone who's sensitive to noise to look elsewhere or keep it well away from bedrooms

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder Dual Outlet
text: Brilliant for feeding two cats fairly. One of my cats was always stealing from the other's bowl and the bigger one was getting fat whilst the smaller one wasn't getting enough. The dual-outlet PETLIBRO has sorted this completely. Both bowls dispense simultaneously so there's no opportunity for theft. Setup was very easy, the app works well, and I can see in the feeding log that both portions are being eaten. Really chuffed with this purchase

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder WiFi 5G and 2.4G Compatible
text: Decent enough but WiFi is hit and miss. The mechanical side of this feeder is fine - portions are roughly accurate and it's not dispensed a wrong meal yet in two months. The WiFi connection is less impressive though. It works maybe 80% of the time, which sounds acceptable until you realise the 20% of failures are unpredictable. You might go to check your cats are fed whilst at work and just get an error message. It does fall back on the stored schedule so the cats don't go hungry, but you lose the peace of mind that remote monitoring is supposed to provide

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L Sealed Hopper
text: Ruined a whole bag of food. The lid seal on this feeder is nowhere near airtight enough. I filled it with a brand new 2kg bag of premium kibble, and within ten days the food had gone stale and slightly soft from moisture in the air. My cats refused to eat it and I had to throw the lot away. A sealed hopper is the most basic requirement of an automatic feeder and this one fails at it. Completely unacceptable at this price point

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly — cat went hungry. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi version after seeing it recommended on a few cat forums. Setup was straightforward enough, connected to the app without too much faff. However, within the first week it kept dropping off our 2.4GHz network entirely. I'd get a notification saying the feeder was offline, rush home to check, and the poor thing hadn't been fed her morning meal. Customer service told me to 'move the router closer' which isn't exactly practical. Returned it in the end. Shame, because when it did work, the app was actually quite intuitive and the portions seemed accurate

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Timer
text: Absolute rubbish. Food jammed on day three.. Day one: fine. Day two: fine. Day three: completely jammed solid. Dry kibble got stuck in the dispensing mechanism and nothing came out. My cat was meowing at 6am and I had no idea until I came downstairs. Not acceptable for something that's supposed to give you peace of mind. Sent it back immediately

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Brilliant bit of kit — genuinely changed our routine. We've had the Cat Mate C500 for about eight months now and honestly couldn't be without it. We have two cats with very different feeding schedules — one's on a diet and the other needs smaller, more frequent meals due to a stomach issue. Being able to programme separate portion sizes and times for each has been a game changer. The build quality feels solid, the ice packs keep wet food fresh for a good few hours, and both cats took to it immediately. Cleaning is a bit fiddly with the separate compartments but nothing a bottle brush can't sort. Highly recommend for multi-cat households

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Dry Food Dispenser 4L
text: Does the job but the noise woke us up every morning. The motor on this thing is surprisingly loud for 6am. Our bedroom is directly above the kitchen and it would wake both of us up every single morning. The feeder itself works reliably — no jamming, portions are roughly correct — but I wasn't expecting it to sound like a small lawnmower dispensing kibble. If your feeder is well away from bedrooms it'd probably be fine. Knocked two stars off purely for the noise

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Battery Backup 5L
text: Battery backup is a complete lie. The listing clearly states it has battery backup in case of power cuts. We had a brief power cut last Tuesday — maybe 20 minutes — and when the power came back on the entire thing had reset. All my programmed feeding times were gone. The batteries clearly do nothing to preserve the settings or continue operation. Contacted the seller who offered me a 10% discount on a future purchase. Absolutely not

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Really pleased overall, minor app grumbles. The PETLIBRO app is mostly good but it does crash occasionally on my Android phone. It's fine on my wife's iPhone so perhaps it's an Android optimisation issue. The feeder itself is excellent — quiet, consistent, and our ginger boy has fully accepted it as his new best friend. Capacity is generous and we can go away for a long weekend without worrying. Would be five stars if they sorted the Android app out

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: Portion sizes wildly inaccurate. Set it to dispense 30g per meal as per the vet's instructions. Weighed what actually came out: anywhere between 18g and 47g depending on the meal. That's not a minor variance — that's potentially dangerous if your cat is on a strict diet. Tried recalibrating several times using the app's built-in calibration tool but it made little difference. For a cat with kidney disease who needs precise portions, this simply isn't good enough

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: SureFeed is worth every penny. Yes it's expensive. No, I don't regret it one bit. We have three cats and our eldest kept stealing food from the younger two. The microchip recognition on the SureFeed is spot-on — it only opens for the correct cat and closes the moment another one approaches. Setup was genuinely easy, took about ten minutes including registering all three microchips. It connects to the Sure Petcare app which is reliable and gives you feeding history. If you have multiple cats with different dietary needs, just buy this. Stop looking at cheaper alternatives

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with LCD Screen
text: Broke after 6 weeks. Motor stopped working completely. Cat not amused. Seller wants me to pay return postage. Avoid

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Feeder
text: Cleaning is a proper nightmare. The feeder works well enough and my cat is happy with it. My problem is the cleaning. The hopper doesn't detach easily — you basically have to dismantle the whole unit to give it a proper clean, and the corners of the food bowl collect residue that's really hard to shift. I clean it weekly and it still takes the best part of half an hour. Other than that, it's reliable and quiet. If you don't mind the cleaning faff, it's decent value

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Handled a 10-day holiday without issue. Left our two moggies in the care of a neighbour who just topped up the water and checked in daily. The PETLIBRO ran faultlessly for the entire 10 days — no jamming, no connectivity issues, correct portions every time. I could watch the feeding logs in the app from Portugal which was very reassuring. Took off one star because the power cable is incredibly short and awkwardly placed, which made positioning the unit near a socket more difficult than it needed to be

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder WiFi Enabled 6L
text: App requires account creation just to use basic features. I don't want to create an account and hand over my email address just to set a feeding schedule on a cat feeder. The manual timer mode is buried in the instructions and barely functional without the app. Feels like data harvesting dressed up as a smart product. The hardware itself seems fine but the software experience is unnecessarily invasive. Two stars because the feeder technically works, but I resent the forced account creation

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder
text: My anxious cat actually loves it. I was worried my rescue cat would be frightened of an automatic feeder — she's quite timid and startles easily. I needn't have worried. I introduced it slowly, leaving it unplugged for a few days so she could sniff it, then started using it with the motor sound on low. Within a week she was sitting in front of it waiting for her meals like she'd always had one. The voice recording feature is lovely — I recorded my own voice saying her name and it plays before dispensing. Really thoughtful addition

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6 Meal Programmable
text: Dispensed an entire day's food in one go. Woke up on the second morning to find my cat had been given all six portions simultaneously overnight. She'd eaten herself sick — literally. The scheduling had somehow reset and rather than skipping the missed times, it dispensed everything at once. Vet visit cost me £85. The feeder cost £45. Currently awaiting a refund while my cat recovers on a bland diet. Absolutely furious

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Good capacity, slight kibble size issues. We use a large breed dry food with fairly big kibble pieces and occasionally they do get a bit sluggish going through the dispenser — not a full jam, more of a slow trickle. Switching to a slightly smaller kibble size (as recommended in the manual, which I probably should have read first) solved most of it. Capacity is excellent, we fill it once a week for two cats. Quiet enough not to disturb us and the timer is accurate. Would buy again

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L with Twist Lock Lid
text: Lid cracked after a month. The plastic quality is disappointing. The hopper lid developed a hairline crack after about four weeks of normal daily use — just lifting it off to refill. It doesn't affect the function but I'm now concerned about plastic getting into the food and it looks shabby. For the price I'd expect better materials. The actual dispensing mechanism works fine so I'm not returning it, but I wouldn't buy this brand again

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Perfect for our elderly cat on small frequent meals. Our 17-year-old tabby needs small amounts of food little and often due to a sensitive stomach. Before the feeder, we were getting up at 5am to give her a small breakfast, then again mid-morning, lunchtime and so on. The Cat Mate C500 has given us our lives back. She gets six small meals a day at consistent times, her weight has stabilised and the vet is very pleased. It's quiet, easy to clean (the individual meal trays go straight in the dishwasher) and the ice packs actually do keep the food cool. Brilliant product

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4 Meal LCD Timer
text: Instructions clearly translated from another language. The feeder itself is functional but setting it up was an ordeal because the instruction manual reads like it's been through three rounds of automatic translation. 'Press button food time until light flash confirm schedule' is not a useful instruction. I eventually found a YouTube tutorial by a Canadian bloke that explained it in plain English. Once programmed it works fine — reliable timing, decent capacity — but the documentation needs a complete rewrite for the UK market

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder WiFi Smart App Control 6L
text: Connected, then immediately disconnected, forever. Three hours trying to get this onto our home network. It connected once, I saw it in the app, then it immediately dropped off and has never reconnected since. Tried resetting the router, tried setting up a dedicated 2.4GHz network, tried moving the feeder right next to the router. Nothing. The customer support chat is automated and useless. Currently using it as a very expensive manual bowl while I wait for the refund to process. Do not buy if you actually need the WiFi features

product_name: Cat Mate C10 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Solid budget option if you don't need the app. Bought this as a backup feeder for when we're away for a night or two. No WiFi, no app, just a simple dial and a few buttons — and that's exactly what I wanted. Battery powered so no trailing cables to worry about. It's been dependable for six months, holds enough dry food for four days for one cat, and the motor is relatively quiet. It's not fancy but it does what it says. If you want something simple and reliable without the tech faff, this is your feeder

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly — completely unreliable. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Cat Feeder about three months ago and the WiFi connectivity is an absolute nightmare. It drops off the network at least twice a week and I've had to reset the whole thing from scratch each time. Wouldn't be so bad if it just reverted to the programmed schedule, but no — it defaults to dispensing nothing until you reconnect and reconfigure. Came home from a weekend away to find my cats hadn't been fed for nearly a day because the app showed everything was fine on my end but the feeder had quietly disconnected overnight. Customer service told me to 'move the feeder closer to the router' which I'd already done. Genuinely stressful if you're relying on this when travelling. Keeping it for now but looking at alternatives

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Six months in and still going strong. Honestly one of the best purchases I've made for my two cats. The Cat Mate C300 has been running every single day for six months without a single issue. Portions are accurate, the cats have taken to it brilliantly, and the dual power supply with battery backup gives me real peace of mind during power cuts. Couldn't be happier

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L Gravity Dispenser
text: Food jammed on day three. Useless.. Third day of use and the kibble completely jammed the dispensing mechanism. Tried clearing it, tried smaller kibble as suggested in the manual, tried everything. It just stops mid-dispense and sits there making a grinding noise. Returned it

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with App Control
text: Good concept, portions wildly inconsistent. The PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder looks lovely and setup was straightforward enough. My main gripe is the portion sizes. I set it to dispense 10g per meal but it ranges anywhere between 7g and 14g depending on how the food has settled in the hopper. For a cat on a strict veterinary diet this simply isn't good enough. I've started weighing the bowl before and after each dispense and the variance is genuinely worrying. It's fine if your cat is healthy and you're not calorie counting, but for a cat managing weight issues I'd look elsewhere. The app itself is fine, scheduling works reliably, and it's fairly quiet. Just don't trust the gram measurements

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Really pleased overall — minor app grumble. Set up in about ten minutes, programmes hold perfectly, and my tabby Margot has adapted to the schedule within a week. The only thing stopping this being five stars is the companion app, which occasionally refuses to load the feeding history and needs force-closing. Not a dealbreaker but a bit irritating. Would recommend

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Wet and Dry Feeder
text: Battery backup failed when I needed it most. We had a power cut last month — fairly common in our rural area — and I assumed the three AA batteries I'd fitted would kick in and keep the schedule running. They didn't. My cat missed two meals overnight before I noticed the feeder had simply switched off. Checked the batteries, they were fine. The backup system just doesn't appear to work as described. I've since tested it by unplugging intentionally and it fails about half the time. That's the whole point of having a battery backup. Deeply disappointed

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Transformed our mornings. No more 5am howling! The PETLIBRO feeder goes off at 6:30 and both cats are waiting for it rather than trampolining on my face. Build quality is solid, the hopper holds enough for about two weeks, and I love that I can set it manually from the unit itself without needing the app. Brilliant bit of kit

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L with Timer
text: Absolutely dreadful noise at 3am. The motor on this thing sounds like a small lawnmower. Our bedroom is one floor up and two rooms away from where the feeder sits in the kitchen. We can still hear every single dispense cycle clearly enough to wake us both up. The product description says 'ultra-quiet motor' which is a barefaced lie. Returned within a week

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Portion Control
text: Fine for the price but hard to clean properly. The feeder itself works as described but cleaning it is a real faff. The hopper doesn't detach easily and the chute where food travels through is narrow and awkward to get a brush into. I've resorted to using cotton buds for the tight corners. Given that old kibble and moisture can go off and make cats ill, I'd want this to be much more user-friendly to disassemble. SureFeed's products are easier in this regard. Marks down for that but it functions reliably day to day

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Perfect for my anxious cat. My rescue cat Biscuit was always anxious around mealtimes, bolting her food and then being sick. Switching to the Cat Mate C300 with six small meals spread through the day has genuinely changed her behaviour and her digestion. Vet is pleased too. Simple to set up, reliable, and the slow-dispense meals suit her perfectly. Cannot recommend highly enough

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: App stopped working after an update. Everything was fine for the first two months and then an app update in October completely broke the scheduling function. The feeder still runs on its last saved programme but I can no longer change meal times or portion sizes through the app — it just throws an error. Emailed support three weeks ago, received one response asking for my phone model, then nothing. The feeder still dispenses on the old schedule so my cats are fed, but I can't adjust anything. Really poor aftercare

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Solid feeder, just watch the kibble size. Works brilliantly with standard-sized kibble. I made the mistake of trying it with a smaller prescription food and it jammed twice in a week. Switched back to regular kibble and it's been faultless for four months. Worth reading the kibble size guidance in the manual before you commit. Four stars because that information should be more prominent in the product listing

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Digital Timer
text: Dispensed an entire day's food in one go. Set up the programme correctly — or so I thought — and came home to find my cat had been fed roughly eight portions in one sitting and was very unwell. The timer had somehow triggered all six scheduled meals within about twenty minutes of being plugged in. Reset it, same thing happened. Vet bill came to £180. Avoid

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Does exactly what it says. No fuss, no faff. Filled it up, programmed three meals a day, pressed go. That was four months ago and it hasn't missed a single feed. My cat is healthier, less demanding, and I can go away for a long weekend without guilt. The Cat Mate is worth every penny

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Good but gets smelly quickly in warm weather. During summer the hopper retains smells from the kibble much more than expected, even after cleaning. We have a south-facing kitchen so it gets warm and I worry about the food quality by the end of a full hopper. Might suit people with cooler homes better. Otherwise the feeder functions well and the schedule has never slipped

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Portion Control 5L
text: Cats learned to shake the food out manually. Within two days both my cats had worked out that violently headbutting the feeder would cause extra kibble to spill out of the chute. Completely defeats the purpose of portion control. I've wedged it between the wall and a heavy plant pot now which has mostly sorted it, but for £45 I'd expect a sturdier base. Design flaw

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder Dual Hopper
text: Really impressed with the dual hopper. Bought this for my two cats who eat different foods — one is on a renal diet and the other eats standard adult food. The dual hopper setup on the PETLIBRO works a treat, each side dispensing independently to separate bowls. Setup took about twenty minutes and it's been reliable for three months. Only minor issue is the divider between hoppers could be tighter as the odd piece of kibble crosses over. Overall very happy

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with Timer
text: Stopped working after 6 weeks. Motor died completely six weeks in. Just sits there clicking without dispensing anything. Amazon accepted the return but I wasted six weeks getting my cats used to the routine only to have to start over. Cheap components, clearly

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Works, but the instructions are baffling. The feeder functions once you've worked out how to programme it, but the instruction booklet reads as though it's been translated from Mandarin using a dictionary from 1987. I spent two hours on YouTube finding someone who'd done a walkthrough before I understood the settings. Once it clicked it was fine, and it's been reliable since. Would genuinely give five stars if the instructions were written in comprehensible English. Surely not too much to ask

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Finally sleeping past 5am. Life-changing. My two Bengals used to scream the house down from half four every morning. One week with the PETLIBRO on a 5:45 schedule and they've completely stopped waking us up. They just wait by the feeder instead. Reliable, easy to set up, and the app is genuinely intuitive. My only regret is not buying it sooner

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly — utterly useless. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi feeder about six weeks ago and I genuinely cannot rely on it. The WiFi connection drops at least twice a week, and when it does, the scheduled feeds simply don't happen. I came home from a long day at work to find my cat hadn't been fed since 7am. The app sends a disconnection notification, but only after the fact — hardly helpful when you're not near your phone. Customer support told me to move my router closer, which isn't possible in my flat layout. The feeder itself is well-built and the hopper holds a decent amount of kibble, but what's the point of a smart feeder that isn't reliably smart? Reverting to a basic timer model until this brand sorts out its firmware

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Brilliant for our two moggies. We've had this Cat Mate C500 for about four months and it's been absolutely faultless. Programmes up to five meals a day, portions are consistent, and both cats have taken to it immediately. Setup took under ten minutes. Highly recommend

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Portion Control
text: Food jammed on day three. On the third day of use the kibble completely jammed in the dispensing mechanism. I had to disassemble the entire unit to clear it out. Used the recommended kibble size — medium biscuits — so I'm not sure what went wrong. Won't be buying PETLIBRO again

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with LCD Display
text: Good feeder, slightly fiddly to clean. Really pleased with this overall. My cats are fed on time every morning and evening without me having to drag myself out of bed at 5am. The only gripe is that the hopper is a pain to clean — the auger section isn't fully detachable and kibble dust builds up in the corners. That said, a bottle brush sorts it well enough. Would still recommend for the reliability alone

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Portions are wildly inconsistent. The idea is great but the execution lets it down. I set it to dispense one portion (which the manual says is roughly 10g) but I've weighed the actual output across seven consecutive feeds and it ranged from 7g to 14g. For a cat on a strict diet prescribed by the vet, that variability is simply not acceptable. The unit itself is quiet and connects to WiFi fine, so it's not all bad — just not reliable enough for controlled feeding

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with WiFi and Battery Backup
text: Battery backup is a complete lie. The product listing and the box both prominently advertise a battery backup so feeds continue during power cuts. I tested this by unplugging the unit — nothing happened. No feed at the scheduled time, nothing. Inserted fresh batteries and tried again: still nothing. Contacted the seller who suggested the batteries might be dead on arrival. Replaced with brand new Duracells — same result. The battery backup feature simply does not work on this unit. This is misleading advertising and I've raised a return request. Very disappointed

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with App Control
text: Transformed our mornings. Cannot believe we waited so long to buy one of these. Our cat Biscuit used to wake us up at 4:30am without fail. Since setting up the PETLIBRO feeder to dispense a small portion at 5:15am he sleeps right through until we get up. The app is intuitive, setup was straightforward, and the build quality feels premium. Worth every penny

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: App is dreadful. The feeder hardware itself seems decent but the companion app is genuinely one of the worst I've used. It requires an account just to set basic feeding schedules, it crashed twice during initial setup, and the push notifications arrive anything up to 20 minutes late. There's no way to use the feeder fully offline — even basic scheduling requires an internet connection, which seems like poor design. Considering returning it purely because of the software

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Reliable and quiet. Six months in and not a single missed feed. Quiet motor, decent sized hopper, easy to fill. My elderly cat is on a four-meals-a-day routine and this handles it perfectly. The Cat Mate C500 is exactly what it says on the tin

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with LCD Display
text: Noisy enough to wake me up. The feeder is positioned in the kitchen, which is next to our bedroom. Every time it dispenses — even at the 7am scheduled feed — the motor whirring is loud enough to filter through the wall and wake me up. Not quite the solution I was looking for. During the day you'd never notice it, but at night or early morning it's quite intrusive. May move it to the hallway and see if that helps

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with WiFi and Battery Backup
text: Broke after 5 weeks. Motor stopped working entirely. The unit powers on and the display works, but the dispensing mechanism just clicks and whirrs without moving any food. Tried clearing any potential blockage — nothing in there. Five weeks of use. Absolute rubbish build quality for the price

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 6L Dual Cats
text: Great capacity, cats approved. The 6-litre hopper lasts our two cats about ten days which means we're not constantly refilling. Both cats figured it out within a day and now sit patiently waiting for the dispensing sound. Took off one star because the lid locking mechanism feels a bit flimsy — I worry a determined cat might eventually figure it out

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Kibble jams every few days without fail. I really wanted this to work. The design is attractive, the app is actually quite good, and when it functions properly the portions are reasonably accurate. However, every three or four days the kibble bridges across the hopper opening and nothing comes out. My cat has been left without food twice because of this. I've tried slightly smaller kibble — same problem. The feeder needs a stirring mechanism or an agitator of some kind. As it stands I don't trust it enough to use it when I'm away from home, which rather defeats the purpose

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Exactly what I needed for night shifts. I work nights three times a week and felt terrible leaving my cat without her evening meal. This feeder has been a godsend. Simple to programme, no WiFi faff needed — just set the times on the unit itself. She's happy, I'm happy. Brilliant bit of kit

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with LCD Display
text: Cleaning is a right faff. Functionally it does the job, but whoever designed this clearly never had to clean it. The food bowl is dishwasher safe which is great, but the hopper and chute are full of awkward angles and crevices where stale kibble collects. I've taken to cleaning it fortnightly with a bottle brush and even that doesn't fully reach everywhere. For something in contact with your pet's food daily, easier cleaning really should be a priority for the designers

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with App Control
text: Arrived with a cracked hopper. Opened the box to find a visible crack running down one side of the hopper. Obviously a returns job. Packaging looked fine so it was damaged before shipping. Waiting on a replacement but not a great first impression

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Solid feeder for the price. Been using this for three months without any real issues. The display is easy to read, programming is intuitive even without the instructions, and it's been consistent with portions. My one complaint is the power cable is quite short — about 1.2 metres — which limits where you can position it. An extra metre would make placement much more flexible. Otherwise, happy with the purchase

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Voice Recorder and WiFi
text: The voice recording feature is gimmicky and poor quality. Lots of these feeders offer a voice recording function so your pet hears your voice at mealtimes. Nice idea in theory. In practice the recording quality on this model is so tinny and distorted that my cat was actually startled the first time it played and knocked the whole unit over. The recording length is also very short — about three seconds — which isn't enough to say anything meaningful. The feeding function itself works adequately, but I'd skip any model that leads with this feature as a selling point

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Two years and still going strong. Just reordering as a gift for my sister so thought I'd leave a review. My own Cat Mate C500 has been running twice daily for over two years without a single problem. Never jammed, never missed a feed, batteries lasted about eight months. It's a boring review because there's genuinely nothing to complain about. If you want something reliable without any app nonsense, buy this

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Good when it works, frustrating when it doesn't. The WiFi connectivity is hit and miss — about once a week it drops off the network and requires a manual reset by holding the button on the unit. Not a disaster if you're at home, but the whole point is to use it when you're away. On the positive side, the portions are consistent, the hopper is easy to fill, and the app design is clean and modern. If they can fix the connectivity stability with a firmware update I'd bump this to four stars easily. As it stands, three stars feels about right

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Wi-Fi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Wi-Fi drops constantly — utterly useless. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary Wi-Fi feeder about six weeks ago and I've had nothing but grief with the connectivity. The app disconnects at least three or four times a week, which means I get no feeding confirmations and half the time I can't tell if my cat has actually been fed. Contacted support and they told me to 'move the router closer' — not exactly practical advice when your router is on the other side of a flat. The feeder itself is reasonably well built and the hopper holds a decent amount of kibble, but if the whole point is remote monitoring and you can't rely on the Wi-Fi, what's the point? Returned it in the end

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Absolute lifesaver for early mornings. Our two cats used to wake us up at 5am without fail. Since getting the Cat Mate C500 three months ago, we've had uninterrupted sleep and the cats seem perfectly happy with their scheduled meals. Easy to programme, portions seem accurate enough, and it's whisper quiet. Brilliant bit of kit

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Stainless Steel Bowl
text: Food jammed on day three. Genuinely disappointed. The PETLIBRO air-tight feeder looked great in the photos but the kibble jammed solid in the dispensing mechanism by day three. I came home to find my cat sitting in front of an empty bowl looking very unimpressed, and the drum had completely seized up with bits of biscuit lodged in the rotor. I had to dismantle the whole thing to clear it. Tried smaller kibble as suggested online — jammed again within a week. Not acceptable for something you're supposed to be able to rely on when you're out at work all day

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder
text: Works well, just a bit noisy at night. Really pleased with this overall. The SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder does exactly what it says — only opens for our cat and not the dog, which was the whole reason we bought it. Setup was straightforward and it's been reliable for four months. My only gripe is that the motor makes a fairly loud whirring noise when it opens, which wakes me up if the cat feeds at 3am. A minor complaint really, and I'd still recommend it

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Timer
text: Portions wildly inconsistent. The portion sizes on this Automatic Pet Feeder are all over the place. I set it to dispense one portion and sometimes you get a tiny scraping of food and other times a massive pile. My vet suggested measured feeding to help with my cat's weight, so an unreliable feeder is genuinely counterproductive. The clock keeps perfect time and it's easy to clean, I'll give it that, but accurate portions are the whole point of buying one of these things

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 5G
text: Decent but the app needs serious work. Mixed feelings about this one. Hardware-wise the PETLIBRO Granary is solid — good capacity, nice and airtight, easy to fill. But the companion app is genuinely frustrating. The scheduling interface is clunky, notifications are hit and miss, and it logged me out twice for no apparent reason. When you're travelling and relying on remote feeding, you need an app you can trust. They clearly spent more time on the feeder itself than the software. Giving three stars because the actual feeding mechanism works fine when the app cooperates

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: Our anxious rescue cat has taken to it brilliantly. We were worried our rescue cat Mabel would be spooked by an automatic feeder but she took to the SureFeed Microchip feeder within two days. The gradual introduction mode is a lovely touch — we started with the lid fully open and slowly trained her to accept it closing. Now she uses it without any hesitation. Knowing that our greedy Labrador can't steal her food has been a game changer for the whole household. Really well thought out product

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with Battery Backup
text: Battery backup failed when we needed it most. We had a power cut while we were away on holiday and the battery backup on this feeder did absolutely nothing. Came back to two very hungry cats and a feeder that had simply stopped working. The listing clearly states it has a battery backup function. When I investigated, the batteries had corroded inside the compartment despite being brand new Duracells. The battery housing is clearly poorly designed and doesn't protect against any moisture. Disgusted. Our pet sitter thankfully checked in otherwise this could have been much worse

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Great for dry food, not for wet. Does exactly what I needed for my cat's morning dry food portion. Simple to set up — had it running within ten minutes of opening the box. My only note is don't try to use it with wet or semi-moist food; it simply isn't designed for it and will make a horrible mess. As a dry kibble dispenser it's been faultless for two months

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Cleaning it is a proper nightmare. The feeder works well enough in terms of dispensing food on schedule, but getting it clean is an absolute ordeal. The hopper doesn't separate from the motor unit easily, and there are so many little nooks and corners inside the dispensing drum that old kibble gets stuck and goes stale. I ended up with a faintly musty smell after about three weeks. For something that's dispensing food to your pet, hygiene should be a priority. I spend more time cleaning this than I ever did just filling a bowl twice a day

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Six months in and not a single problem. Bought this Cat Mate C500 back in January and it has dispensed every single meal on time without fail. I have three cats and rotate between two feeders. The build quality is excellent, portions are consistent, and the five-meal capacity suits our schedule perfectly. Would absolutely buy again

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Voice Recorder 6L
text: Stopped working after 11 days. Eleven days. That's how long this lasted before the motor gave up entirely. The drum just stopped rotating mid-morning. I reset it, changed the batteries, unplugged and replugged — nothing. My cat missed two meals before I noticed. The seller offered a replacement but given how quickly the first one failed I have zero confidence in the product. Avoid

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Voice Recorder 4L
text: The voice recording feature is a nice touch but.... My kids loved recording a little message to call the cats for their meals, which is genuinely adorable. And to be fair, the cats do seem to respond to the familiar voice, which is sweet. However, the recording quality is quite tinny and distorts at anything above medium volume. The feeding mechanism itself is reliable and portions are reasonable. It's a fun extra feature but not quite as polished as I'd hoped. Three stars — perfectly adequate, just not outstanding

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Much better than the cheap one we had before. After our last no-brand feeder jammed twice in a month, we upgraded to the PETLIBRO Granary and the difference is noticeable immediately. The hopper seal is genuinely airtight — kibble stays fresh for much longer. App setup took about ten minutes and has been stable on our home Wi-Fi. Dropped one star purely because the bowl could be a bit deeper; our cat is quite a messy eater and food ends up on the floor

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Wi-Fi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Wi-Fi only works on 2.4GHz — wish they'd said so clearly. Spent nearly an hour trying to get this connected before I found buried in a FAQ that it only supports 2.4GHz networks. My router broadcasts both bands under the same name so I had to split them to get it working. Once connected it functions fine, but this limitation really should be on the product listing in plain English, not hidden away. Frustrating

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder
text: Sorted our cats' feeding rivalry overnight. We have one cat who wolfs his food down and then pushes the other one away from her bowl. Two SureFeed microchip feeders have completely solved this. Each feeder only opens for its registered cat, so both cats eat their own food at their own pace. It sounds expensive but it's been worth every penny. Genuinely transformed mealtimes

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with LCD Display
text: Reliable but incredibly loud. This feeder has been going strong for four months which I appreciate, but the motor noise is really something. Every time it dispenses — which for us is four times a day — there's a grinding, whirring clatter that sounds like a small piece of machinery failing. My flat is open plan so there's no escaping it. If you're a light sleeper and your cat eats early, prepare to be woken up. Works well, just needs a quieter motor

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 3L with Timer
text: Absolutely not child or cat proof. My very determined cat learned to paw the lid open within about forty minutes of us setting this up. She simply bypassed the whole scheduling system and helped herself. I know that's arguably impressive but I paid £45 for a feeder that my cat defeated in under an hour. Back to basics

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Excellent capacity for long weekends away. The six-litre hopper on the PETLIBRO Granary means we can leave our two cats for a long weekend without needing to arrange a sitter for every meal. Set up four scheduled portions per cat, double-checked via the app, and both cats were perfectly fed while we were away. Great peace of mind. I've knocked a star off because the app crashed twice but it self-corrected and the meals still dispensed, so it seems the local schedule is stored on the device itself, which is reassuring

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Portions too small even on maximum setting. My cat is a large Maine Coon and needs a proper portion at each meal. Even with this feeder set to its maximum dispense level, the amount of food coming out isn't enough for him. He sits and waits expectantly after each feeding as if to say that's not nearly enough. The feeder might be fine for a smaller cat but the listing doesn't make clear how limited the maximum portion actually is. Disappointed

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly — utterly useless. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi automatic feeder about six weeks ago and I've had nothing but grief with the app. The feeder drops off the network every few days and I have to go through the whole setup process again. Twice now I've been at work convinced my cat has been fed, only to come home and find an empty bowl and a very angry tabby. The feeder itself seems fine mechanically, but if the connectivity is this unreliable I might as well just use a timer feeder. Customer service sent me a generic troubleshooting email that didn't help at all. Disappointing

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Brilliant for our two cats. We've had this Cat Mate C500 for nearly eight months now and it's been absolutely faultless. Feeds both cats at 7am and 6pm every single day without fail. Setup took about ten minutes, the portions are consistent, and the cats have completely adjusted to the schedule. Couldn't be happier

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Timer
text: Food jammed on day three. Catastrophic.. The auger mechanism on this automatic pet feeder jammed solid with the dry kibble I use. I'd specifically checked the recommended kibble sizes beforehand and was using exactly the right type. On day three the motor just hummed and nothing came out — my cat went unfed all morning while I was at the office. When I took the unit apart to clear the blockage I found the plastic components are incredibly flimsy. The whole thing feels like it was designed to fail. Sending it straight back

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder
text: Really solid feeder, minor gripes. Using the PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder for three months now. Portions are accurate, the voice recording feature is a lovely touch and my cat comes running when she hears my voice. Knocking off one star purely because cleaning is a faff — the food hopper doesn't fully detach and you have to use a narrow brush to get into the corners. Not a dealbreaker but worth knowing before you buy

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with LCD Display
text: Portion sizes are wildly inaccurate. The portions on this feeder can vary by what feels like 30-40% between meals. I weighed several consecutive portions out of curiosity and got results ranging from 18g to 27g when I'd set it to 20g. For a cat on a strict diet following health advice from the vet this is completely unacceptable. The mechanism itself is noisy enough to wake me at 5am from the next room. Not fit for purpose in my opinion

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Game changer for early mornings. Absolute lifesaver. My cat used to wake me at 5am every single morning without fail. Since setting up the Cat Mate C300 to dispense at 6:15am she ignores me completely and just waits by the feeder. Best £40 I've ever spent

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder 5L
text: Works fine but the app is a nightmare. The feeder itself does its job, but the companion app for this PETLIBRO WiFi model is genuinely one of the worst I've encountered on Android. It crashed three times during initial setup, it doesn't show reliable feeding logs, and the push notifications are inconsistent. I've resorted to just programming the scheduled feeds directly on the unit and ignoring the app entirely, which defeats the point of paying extra for WiFi capability. Would give five stars if the app matched the hardware quality

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Battery Backup 4L
text: Battery backup failed — cat went without food all weekend. We had a brief power cut on Saturday morning and the battery backup on this feeder, which I had specifically checked was working, did absolutely nothing. The feeder simply stopped and didn't resume when the power came back on either — it needed a full manual reset. We were away for the weekend and came back on Sunday evening to a cat that had only been fed once in over 48 hours. I am absolutely furious. The whole point of a battery backup is that it handles exactly this scenario. The product description is misleading at best. Avoid if you ever leave your pet unattended

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 5L
text: Mostly great — noisy at night though. Happy with the PETLIBRO overall. Reliable portions, easy to programme, and the 5L hopper means I only refill it every two weeks or so for my one cat. The only thing I'd flag is the dispensing mechanism is noticeably loud. I have it in the kitchen and the bedroom is directly above — the 6am feed wakes me every morning. If you're a light sleeper, factor that in

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder
text: Clever design, terrible execution. The concept behind this SureFeed-style microchip feeder is excellent and I really wanted it to work. Unfortunately the lid mechanism has become increasingly sluggish over two months to the point where it now takes four or five seconds to open after my cat approaches. She's given up waiting and just paws at it aggressively, which I'm sure isn't helping. I've cleaned it thoroughly multiple times and the problem persists. For the price I expected considerably better build quality

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder with Camera
text: Solved our multi-cat feeding problem completely. We have three cats and getting them each fed the right amount had been a daily battle for years. The PETLIBRO WiFi feeder has genuinely transformed our routine. Setup was straightforward, the app works reliably on both our iPhones, and the 1080p camera is a lovely bonus — we check in on the cats during the day. It's been running flawlessly for four months. Highly recommended

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Timer 3L
text: Broke after 11 days. Motor failed completely. Eleven days. Returned

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Cleaning is an absolute mission. The feeder works as described and my cat is happy enough with it, but I dread the weekly clean. The food hopper has all sorts of awkward angles and recesses that trap old kibble dust and the whole thing needs to be almost fully dismantled to clean properly. I've started doing it every ten days rather than weekly just because it takes so long. A better-designed product would prioritise hygiene. Worth knowing before you buy if cleanliness matters to you, which with pet food equipment it really should

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Simple, reliable, no fuss. Bought the Cat Mate C300 after reading endless reviews. It does exactly what it says — dispenses at the times you set in the portions you programme. My cats have been fed reliably twice a day for five months without a single missed meal. No app required, no WiFi, no nonsense. Sometimes simple is best

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Portion Control
text: Portion dial is completely vague. There's no meaningful calibration on this feeder — just a dial that goes from 1 to 10 with no indication of actual grams dispensed. I've had to weigh portions at every setting to work out what it actually delivers, and even then it varies each time. My cat is meant to be on 55g of dry food per day on vet's advice. This feeder simply cannot deliver that consistently. Functional for free-feeding perhaps, but useless for precise portion control

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder WiFi 6L
text: Excellent value, slight wifi wobbles. For the price this PETLIBRO feeder is really impressive. The hardware is sturdy, the hopper holds loads, and the scheduled feeding works perfectly even when the WiFi drops because it stores the schedule locally. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that the app disconnects from the feeder if I'm away from home on mobile data for more than a day or so, and re-pairing isn't always smooth. But as a basic feeder it's brilliant and my cat is noticeably calmer since we introduced a regular schedule

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with Voice Recorder
text: Frightened my cat half to death. The dispensing noise on this feeder is like a small industrial grinder. My normally bold Bengal bolted out of the room the first time it activated and has refused to go near it since. I've had it running empty for two weeks hoping she'd get used to the sound but she won't go within two metres of it. A feeder your cat actively avoids is not a feeder at all. Absolute waste of money

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Good idea, let down by the app. Hardware is fine. The feeder dispenses reliably and the hopper is a decent size. Losing two stars specifically for the Android app which hasn't been updated in over a year, crashes on my Samsung Galaxy, and doesn't save feeding logs properly. The iOS version apparently works better according to other reviews, so it may depend on your device. Would upgrade the review if they bothered to maintain the software

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder
text: My anxious cat loves it. My rescue cat was always nervous around mealtimes, clearly conditioned by unpredictable feeding in her previous home. Since getting the PETLIBRO and setting consistent meal times she is visibly more relaxed. She sits beside the feeder five minutes before each scheduled feed. The voice recording plays my voice to call her over and she responds to it immediately. Lovely product and I think it has genuinely improved her wellbeing

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L with LCD Screen
text: Great for a month, then constant jamming. The first four weeks with this automatic pet feeder were genuinely promising — consistent portions, quiet enough, easy to set up. Then the jamming started. Every three or four days the kibble would bridge across the hopper outlet and nothing would dispense. I've tried different kibble shapes, I've tried filling it less full, I've tried every suggestion in the manual and online. Nothing has fixed it permanently. It's exhausting to manage something that's supposed to make life easier. A real shame because the fundamentals are good

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly — absolute nightmare. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi automatic cat feeder after seeing good reviews but the WiFi connectivity is genuinely dreadful. It drops off our network at least twice a day and I have to physically walk over and reconnect it. Wouldn't be so bad but we work long hours and the whole point was to feed our cat while we're out. The app sends a notification saying feeding failed but by the time I've seen it and driven home, poor Marmite has been waiting two hours for her tea. Customer service told me to 'move the feeder closer to the router' — it's already three feet away. Returning it

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Brilliant for our two elderly cats. We've had this Cat Mate C500 for eight months now and honestly it's been faultless. Our two elderly cats, Biscuit and Marmalade, are on strict feeding schedules due to kidney issues and this feeder has been an absolute godsend. Portions are accurate, it's dead quiet, and the ice pack compartment keeps wet food fresh overnight. Thoroughly recommend

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Portion Control
text: Food jammed on day three. Three. Days.. Useless

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L Large Capacity
text: Good concept, portions wildly inaccurate. The idea is great and setup was straightforward enough, but I've weighed the portions and they vary by up to 15 grams between scheduled feeds. For a cat on a diet that's significant. Using it for our Maine Coon who's supposed to get 60g per meal and sometimes he gets 45, sometimes 72. It's a lottery. Might be fine for free-feeding cats but not one that needs careful management

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Really solid feeder, minor gripes. Been using this PETLIBRO for six months. Generally very reliable and the 4L hopper means I only refill it once a week. My only complaints are that the lid is quite fiddly to remove for cleaning and the motor makes a whirring noise about 30 seconds before it dispenses, which has started waking me up at the 6am feed. Not dealbreakers, but worth knowing

product_name: Automatic Cat Feeder with Battery Backup 5L
text: Battery backup is a complete lie. The listing clearly states this has a battery backup for power cuts. We had a brief outage last month and came home to find our cats hadn't been fed for six hours. The batteries, which I had installed fresh, had done absolutely nothing. Contacted the seller and they said the batteries only power the clock, not the motor. That information is buried in tiny print. Misleading advertising, full stop. Would give zero stars if I could

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Life-changing for early mornings. I used to be woken up every single morning at 4:30am by my cat Ptolemy sitting on my face demanding breakfast. Three weeks with this feeder and I've had the best sleep of the past four years. He now gets up, potters to his feeder at 5am, eats, and comes back to bed. Absolute game changer

product_name: WOPET Automatic Cat Feeder with Timer
text: Cleaning is a proper ordeal. The feeder itself works reasonably well but getting it clean is horrendous. The dispensing mechanism has about fourteen tiny crevices that all trap old kibble and grease. I've resorted to using a toothbrush to get into the corners. The manufacturer says it's dishwasher safe but put it on a gentle cycle once and the plastic warped slightly. It also smells quite strongly of old food after about a fortnight even with regular wiping. Not great

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder App Controlled
text: App is buggy but the feeder itself is decent. The physical feeder — solid. Reliable, good capacity, quiet enough. But the companion app is awful. It crashes at least once a day on my Android phone, the feeding log doesn't always update, and twice it's shown a successful feed when the feeder hadn't actually dispensed anything. There are reviews going back two years mentioning the same app issues so I don't hold out much hope of it being fixed. Wish there was a version without the app dependency

product_name: Generic Automatic Pet Feeder 3.5L
text: Destroyed itself within a fortnight. The motor seized up completely on day eleven. Cat went hungry, I came home to a feeder making a horrible grinding noise and absolutely no kibble in the bowl. Raised a return request immediately. This felt cheap from the moment I opened the box — thin plastic, wobbly lid, slightly chemical smell. Should have bought the SureFeed instead and saved myself the bother

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder
text: SureFeed is worth every single penny. Yes it's expensive. Yes there are cheaper options. But my greedy tabby Percy was stealing food from our elderly rescue cat Dot, and the SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder has completely solved this. It only opens for Dot's microchip and stays firmly shut when Percy approaches. Both cats are now at healthy weights for the first time in years. The build quality is exceptional, it's easy to clean, and it's been running perfectly for over a year. Don't hesitate

product_name: Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder
text: Noisy enough to wake the whole house. Every single feed sounds like someone's putting gravel through a blender. My bedroom is adjacent to the kitchen and the 6am feed wakes me up without fail. I've read suggestions to put it on a folded tea towel to dampen the vibration but it hasn't made a meaningful difference. My cat doesn't seem bothered by the noise but I certainly am

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder Stainless Steel Bowl
text: Excellent for wet and dry food, just read the instructions. I'd read some reviews about food jamming and was nervous, but I think people are using the wrong kibble size. The instructions are clear that it needs to be small to medium kibble — once I switched from the large biscuits I'd been buying, it's been perfect for three months without a single jam. The scheduling is intuitive and the portion sizes have been spot on. Taking one star off only because the instruction manual is poorly translated

product_name: Automatic Cat Feeder 6 Meal Programmable
text: Programme reset itself twice in one week. Spent twenty minutes programming four daily feeds. Came home that evening to find it had reset to factory settings and our cat hadn't been fed since morning. Reset everything. Three days later, same again. I don't know if it's a firmware issue or a power supply problem but I cannot trust a feeder that randomly forgets its entire schedule. Cat is now staying at my mum's while I find a replacement

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Three years and counting. Just want to leave a review because most of the negative ones seem to be from people who've had theirs a few weeks. Our Cat Mate C500 has been running daily for three years without a single issue. We've been through two international holidays and multiple work trips and it has never once missed a feed or jammed or reset itself. Portions are consistent, it's easy to clean once you get used to the routine, and our two cats are completely unbothered by the dispensing noise. A genuinely reliable bit of kit

product_name: Automatic Cat Feeder 4L Large Capacity Hopper
text: Food goes stale so quickly in that hopper. The feeder dispenses fine but the hopper isn't airtight at all — there's a notable gap around the lid. After a few days the kibble at the bottom starts to smell stale and my cat, who is admittedly quite fussy, began refusing it. I now decant food into it every other day rather than filling it weekly as intended. That rather defeats the purpose of a large capacity feeder. The seal around the lid really should be better

product_name: WOPET Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder 6L
text: Does the job but the voice recorder is pointless. My husband was very excited about recording a message to call the cat to her meals. The speaker is so tinny and quiet that Noodle completely ignores it. We've turned that feature off now. The actual feeding function is perfectly adequate — reliable timing, decent portion sizes, straightforward to set up. It's just a shame the headline feature is so underwhelming

product_name: Automatic Cat Feeder Portion Control with Desiccant
text: Jammed three times in the first week. The dispensing wheel jams if even one piece of kibble gets wedged at an angle, which happens constantly. I had to manually dig out the blockage each time and twice kibble had been ground into powder by the mechanism trying to push through the jam. My cat received zero food from two scheduled feeds because I wasn't home to fix it. This is not fit for purpose. Avoid

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Stainless Steel Bowl
text: Colour options are lovely, functionality is great. Chose the white and grey colour scheme which looks really smart in our kitchen rather than the usual garish plastic. Setup took about ten minutes and the PETLIBRO app connected first try on both mine and my partner's phones. We can both adjust feeding times remotely which is really useful. Slight niggle is that the stainless steel bowl rattles a tiny bit in its housing, but nothing that bothers the cat

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder WiFi Enabled
text: WiFi range is laughably short. Our kitchen is perhaps eight metres from the router with one wall in between. That's it. The feeder loses connection constantly and the app spends more time showing 'device offline' than anything useful. Tried everything — changing channels, getting a WiFi extender, repositioning the router. Nothing works consistently. The feeder dispenses on its internal schedule even when offline, which is the only reason it's getting two stars rather than one, but the whole smart functionality is essentially decorative in our house

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: App is an absolute nightmare to set up. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder with high hopes after reading the glowing reviews. The physical unit itself feels sturdy enough and the capacity is decent, but getting the app connected was genuinely one of the most frustrating experiences I've had with a smart home device. Spent the best part of two hours trying to get it onto my 2.4GHz network — it kept timing out during the pairing process. Even once I got it connected, the app dropped the connection twice in the first week. PETLIBRO support responded eventually but their instructions were just the same generic steps from the manual. If you're not particularly tech-savvy, I'd steer well clear of the WiFi version and just go for a basic timer model. The feeder itself dispenses fine when it works, but the whole point of the WiFi model is the remote control functionality, which simply doesn't function reliably

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: My cats are obsessed and so am I. Absolutely brilliant piece of kit. Set it up in about fifteen minutes, programmed four meals a day for my two Bengals, and it's been running perfectly for three months now. The portion sizes are accurate and consistent every time. Would absolutely recommend to any multi-cat household

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L WiFi Smart Cat Feeder
text: Jammed on day three — cat went hungry. Dreadful. The auger mechanism jammed completely on the third day of use. I'd filled it with the dry kibble recommended in the manual and still it ground to a halt mid-feed. My cat missed her evening meal entirely, which I only discovered when I got home from work. Contacted the seller, who took four days to reply. Returning this immediately and going back to my old Cat Mate which lasted seven years without a single issue

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Solid feeder, slightly fiddly to clean. Really pleased with this overall. My rescue cat Marmite has taken to it brilliantly and his weight has actually stabilised since we started using it, which was the whole point. The only reason I'm not giving five stars is that the food bowl and the dispensing chute are a bit awkward to get properly clean — you can't put them in the dishwasher and there are some tight corners where old kibble dust collects. A bottle brush helps. Minor gripe for an otherwise reliable bit of kit

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder Connect
text: Battery backup completely useless. We had a power cut last month lasting about six hours. Thought I was covered because the product listing specifically mentions battery backup. It was not covered. The unit simply switched off and did not resume feeding until I manually restarted it after the power came back on. Three batteries installed, all fresh, made absolutely no difference. The manufacturer needs to be far more honest in their product description. My elderly cat relies on regular small meals for health reasons and this was genuinely worrying

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Does the job but noisier than expected. The motor on this is louder than I anticipated. My bedroom is directly above where I've placed it in the kitchen and the 6am feed genuinely wakes me up — it sounds a bit like a small food mixer. The cat doesn't seem bothered, fair enough, but I am. Portion accuracy is fine and setup was straightforward. If you're a light sleeper or planning to put it near a bedroom, do factor in the noise

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Lifesaver for early mornings. I work shift patterns and this has genuinely transformed my mornings. My two cats used to wake me up relentlessly from 5am demanding breakfast. Now the feeder goes off at 6:30 and I get a proper lie-in. Brilliant product, easy to programme, no issues whatsoever in four months of daily use

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L Timed Cat Food Dispenser
text: Portion sizes wildly inaccurate. I set it to dispense 10g per meal as directed by my vet for my overweight tabby. After weighing several actual servings, the amounts varied between 7g and 16g — that's a massive range and completely defeats the purpose if you're trying to manage a cat's weight carefully. The machine itself is fine mechanically but if you need precise portions, this is not the one

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Good value, cats approved. Bought this after our old timer model finally gave up. Very easy to set up — had it programmed within ten minutes. The hopper holds enough food for nearly a week for one cat which means we don't have to fuss with it constantly. Docking one star because the lid clip feels a bit flimsy, but three months in and no real complaints

product_name: Vealind Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Stopped working after six weeks. Six weeks. That's all I got out of this before the dispensing motor died completely. No warning, no error message, just silence at feeding time. My cat was sitting by an empty bowl when I woke up. Amazon refunded without any fuss, to be fair, but I've wasted six weeks of my cat's feeding routine on a product that clearly isn't built to last. Spending the extra money on a Cat Mate next time

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Excellent for managing my cat's diabetes. My cat Biscuit was diagnosed with diabetes last year and needs to eat at very precise times to coordinate with his insulin injections. This feeder has been an absolute godsend — it's reliable, the timing is spot-on, and I can programme up to six meals a day with different portion sizes. My vet has commented on how well his glucose levels have stabilised since we got into a consistent routine. Cannot recommend highly enough for cats with medical feeding requirements

product_name: PETLIBRO Air WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: WiFi drops constantly. Our router is literally in the next room and this thing loses connection at least twice a week. When it loses connection you don't get any notification — you only find out when you open the app and see the feeder showing as offline. Scheduled feeds still go through when it's offline, apparently, but you lose all the remote monitoring which is half the reason I bought the WiFi model. Very frustrating

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Cat figured out how to open it. Perfectly decent feeder mechanically. My problem is entirely my own cat's fault — the greedy menace worked out how to nudge the lid open within about a fortnight and helped himself to the entire hopper in one sitting. He's a very determined and rather rotund British Shorthair. The lid isn't designed with determined food thieves in mind. If your cat is sensible, you'll probably be fine. Mine is not sensible

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Really reliable after a rocky start. First week I had some jamming issues with the kibble I was using — turned out the pieces were slightly too large for the mechanism. Switched to a smaller biscuit size and it's been absolutely faultless for two months since. I wish the manual was clearer about recommended kibble dimensions, but once you've got that right it's a genuinely solid bit of kit. The voice recording feature where you can record a meal call is a lovely touch — my cats come running the moment they hear my voice

product_name: PETLIBRO Air WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Useless app, useless support. Three weeks trying to get the companion app to work properly. It connects, then drops, then the schedule disappears, then it tells me the feeder is offline when the feeder is clearly on and dispensing. Contacted support twice. First response was an automated email pointing me to the FAQ. Second response, twelve days later, suggested I delete and reinstall the app — which I had already done six times. The feeder hardware seems fine. The software is a complete shambles. Avoid the WiFi version entirely

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Perfect for my elderly cat. My 17-year-old cat needs small, frequent meals throughout the day due to kidney issues. This feeder lets me programme up to six portions which has made an enormous difference to her wellbeing.
