The portions are consistent and it's very quiet — she's quite timid and loud machines stress her out. Excellent product, very glad I found it

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L Timed Cat Food Dispenser
text: Food goes stale quickly in the bowl. The feeder works as advertised but the design of the food tray means the kibble that sits in the dispensing area before the programmed meal time gets exposed to air and goes soft and stale, particularly in warm weather. My cats started refusing to eat it. The hopper itself is well sealed but the last inch of the dispensing mechanism isn't, and in summer this is a real problem. A minor design flaw that has a significant impact in practice

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Decent but the clock resets on power loss. Overall I'm fairly happy with this but there's one issue that drives me absolutely mad: every time there's even a brief power interruption, the clock resets to midnight and all my scheduled feeds are off until I notice and correct them. For the price point, you'd expect it to have a capacitor or small battery just to maintain the clock settings. A design oversight that's hard to forgive on what is fundamentally a timing device

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 6L
text: Brilliant for holidays. We have a very reliable cat sitter but she can only visit once a day. Having this set up means our cats get their three meals even on the days between visits. Large capacity, solid construction, and the locking lid means our sitter can't accidentally overfeed them. Gives us complete peace of mind when we're away

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L WiFi Smart Food Dispenser
text: Cleaning is genuinely horrible. Nobody warned me how difficult this thing is to clean properly. The auger mechanism that dispenses the food collects a build-up of kibble dust and fat residue that is nearly impossible to remove without fully disassembling the unit, which requires a small screwdriver. The instruction manual suggests wiping it down with a damp cloth, which barely touches the internal parts. For a product that handles food daily, hygiene should be a priority in the design. I clean mine thoroughly once a fortnight and it takes nearly an hour. That's not acceptable

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: App stopped working after firmware update — absolute nightmare. Had the PETLIBRO Granary WiFi feeder for about four months and it was genuinely brilliant until they pushed a firmware update in October. Since then the app crashes every single time I try to schedule a feeding. I've uninstalled, reinstalled, reset the feeder twice and contacted support who just kept sending me the same PDF troubleshooting guide. My cat was relying on this while I was at work and I ended up having to ask my neighbour to pop in and feed her manually. Honestly gutted because when it worked, it was perfect. The hopper holds loads of food and the portion sizes were spot on. But if the app is this fragile, what's the point of a smart feeder? Dropping to two stars until they actually fix this properly. Feels like they just don't test updates before pushing them out

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Timer
text: Woke the whole house up at 3am. This thing is LOUD. The motor sounds like a small hoover. Set it to dispense at 6am and somehow it triggered at 3am instead and scared the life out of me and both cats. Returned immediately

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Really reliable for my two moggies. Been using the Cat Mate C500 for about eight months now and it's been solid. Five meal compartments is plenty for our routine and the cats have taken to it no problem. Ice packs keep wet food fresh overnight which was the main reason I bought this style over a hopper. Only gripe is the lid clips are a bit fiddly to clean properly — you really have to dig into the grooves. But overall very happy and would recommend to anyone wanting something simple without needing an app or wifi

product_name: PETLIBRO Air Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Jammed on day three. Completely useless.. The auger jammed with perfectly normal dry kibble on the third day. Tried cleaning it out, tried a different food brand, tried smaller portion sizes — jammed every single time. My cat went without food for six hours before I noticed. Do not trust this with your pet's welfare

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with Digital Timer
text: Exactly what I needed for early mornings. Bought this so I could have a lie-in at weekends without my cat sitting on my face at 5:30am demanding breakfast. It's worked an absolute treat. Simple to programme, holds enough food for about a week if I'm doing small portions, and my cat has completely transferred his enthusiasm to the machine rather than me. Brilliant purchase

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 5L
text: Portion sizes wildly inconsistent. On paper this should dispense 10g portions but I weighed several consecutive servings and got anywhere between 7g and 18g. That's a massive variance when you're trying to manage a cat's weight on vet's orders. My vet specifically asked me to control Biscuit's intake precisely and this feeder simply cannot do that reliably. The mechanism seems to dispense differently depending on how full the hopper is — more food when it's full, less when it's getting low. Contacted the seller who said 'slight variation is normal' which I don't think is good enough for a product marketed as a health management tool. Two stars because it hasn't broken and the app is fine, but for portion accuracy look elsewhere

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder with Battery Backup 6L
text: Does the job but the battery backup is pointless. The feeder itself works fine on mains power. The problem is the battery backup claims to keep things running during a power cut but when we had an outage last month the schedule was completely wiped and it defaulted back to factory settings. So the backup keeps it powered but doesn't save the programme. Bit of a fundamental flaw really. Middle of the road rating — it's fine as long as your power never goes out

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Two years in and still going strong. Honestly one of the best things I've bought for my cats. The PETLIBRO Granary has been running twice daily since we got it and hasn't missed a single feed. Easy to clean, the hopper seals well so the biscuits stay fresh, and my two cats know exactly when it's about to go off — they sit in front of it about five minutes before. Set it and forget it. Absolutely worth every penny

product_name: PETLIBRO Space Automatic Cat Feeder WiFi
text: Nearly killed my cat — vet bills to prove it. The feeder jammed silently with no alert on the app, no notification, nothing. My cat didn't eat for almost two days while I was away visiting family. By the time I noticed something was wrong via the camera I have set up separately, she was lethargic and needed a vet visit for fluid support. The feeder showed as 'operating normally' in the app the entire time. Any smart feeder worth its salt should detect a jam and send an alert. This one absolutely does not. I will never trust this brand again

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder 3L
text: Good feeder, app needs some work. The hardware itself is great — solid build, decent capacity and my cat has had no trouble eating from it. The portion sizes are accurate enough for our purposes. Dropping one star because the Android app is noticeably worse than the iOS version. Scheduling sometimes doesn't sync properly and you have to close and reopen the app to confirm a feed has actually been set. Not a dealbreaker but a bit annoying when you're paying this much. Would still recommend overall

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L Stainless Steel Bowl
text: Cleaning it is an absolute chore. The food compartment and chute have so many awkward angles and small crevices that old food gets stuck in. I've resorted to using cotton buds to clean the auger tunnel which takes about 20 minutes every week. For a product you're supposed to use with food, the hygiene design is genuinely poor. My previous feeder took five minutes to clean. This one makes me dread wash day

product_name: PETLIBRO Space Automatic Cat Feeder with Camera
text: Sceptical at first but converted now. My husband thought buying an automatic feeder was mad and we'd never use it. Six months later he's the one checking the app to make sure the cats have been fed. Really easy setup, connects to wifi without any fuss, the camera quality is better than I expected and being able to dispense food remotely when we're late home is genuinely useful. Brilliant bit of kit

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Fine for one cat, not great for two. Works perfectly as intended but I naively thought both cats would share nicely. Of course they don't — Archie eats everything and Maisie gets nothing. That's not the feeder's fault, I know. But worth mentioning if you have multiple cats with different appetites or dietary needs. You'll want separate feeders. The feeder itself is reliable and quiet enough, hence three stars

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder WiFi 6L with App Control
text: WiFi drops constantly — useless as a smart device. I have a strong 2.4GHz signal throughout my flat and this feeder drops off the network at least twice a week. Every time it reconnects it loses the feeding schedule and I have to reprogram it. I've tried moving the router closer, changing channels, everything the support team suggested. Nothing works consistently. Just buy a basic timer feeder and save yourself the aggro — the smart features on this simply don't work reliably enough to justify the price premium

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary WiFi Automatic Cat Feeder 5L
text: Handled our holiday perfectly. Left our cat Horatio with the feeder and a neighbour checking in every other day. Two weeks, no issues. The feeder dispensed every meal on schedule, the app showed us feeding history so we could confirm he'd eaten, and he was in fine form when we got back. Great peace of mind for holidays. Only complaint is the voice recording feature — you can record a message to play at feeding time — and Horatio is completely indifferent to it, which is mildly offensive

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L with Twist Lock Lid
text: Food goes stale quickly in the hopper. The lid doesn't seal as airtight as the product photos suggest. After about four days the biscuits at the bottom of the hopper taste noticeably stale — my cat started refusing them which is how I noticed. I now only fill it with a few days' worth at a time which defeats the purpose of having a large hopper. Not what I expected for this price point

product_name: PETLIBRO Air Automatic Cat Feeder 3L
text: My anxious cat has really taken to it. I was worried my rescue cat would be frightened by an automatic feeder but she adapted within two days. The motor on this one is genuinely quiet — just a soft whirr — and she now trots over happily when she hears it start up. Regular mealtimes have also seemed to reduce her anxiety generally. Really pleased with this purchase and the portion consistency has been good too

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with LCD Timer
text: Broke within five weeks. Motor died. No warning, no jam, just stopped dispensing entirely one morning. Five weeks old. Contacted seller and had to send photos, videos and fill out a lengthy form before they'd agree to a replacement. Replacement also developed a rattling noise after two weeks. Absolute rubbish quality. Spent more time dealing with this than it's ever saved me

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 5L with Desiccant Bag
text: Great concept, execution is a bit rough around the edges. The feeder does what it says — food comes out at the right time, most of the time. But the button controls on the unit itself are really stiff and take several presses to register, the instruction manual looks like it's been translated from Mandarin by someone who has never seen a cat, and the bowl is quite shallow so my cat manages to fling biscuits everywhere. Three stars: functional but feels like a version one product that needed more testing before launch

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder 3L
text: Not suitable for larger kibble at all. My vet recommended a joint-support food that comes in larger biscuit sizes and this feeder simply cannot handle it. Jams every single time. I switched back to the standard size kibble and it works fine, but I'm now in the position of choosing between my cat's joint health and having a functioning feeder. The product description says 'suitable for most dry food' which is clearly not accurate. Very frustrating

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Wifi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: Wifi drops constantly — completely unreliable. Bought the PETLIBRO Granary Wifi version after reading decent reviews, but the connection to my home network drops at least twice a day. Each time it loses wifi, the scheduled feeds still run locally which is something, but the app loses all history and I have to reconnect from scratch. Contacted support who told me to move the feeder closer to my router — it's literally two metres away. My kettle connects fine from the kitchen. The hardware itself seems decent enough and the hopper holds a good amount of kibble, but paying the premium for wifi functionality when it barely works half the time feels like a right waste of money. Two stars because at least it does feed the cat most of the time

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L Programmable
text: Jammed on day three. Cat went hungry.. Absolute rubbish. The food jammed in the dispensing mechanism on day three and my cat missed two meals before I noticed. I was at work and had no idea until I got home to find her howling at an empty bowl. The kibble I use isn't even large — it's a standard Royal Canin size — but it bridged across the rotor and nothing came through. Returned it immediately

product_name: Cat Mate C500 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Six months in and still going strong. Honestly one of the best purchases I've made for my two cats. The Cat Mate C500 has been running daily for six months without a single hiccup. I programme five meals a day and the portions are consistent every single time. My cats have actually calmed down around feeding time because they know the machine will deliver — they've stopped pestering me at 5am which alone is worth every penny. Cleaning is straightforward once you get into the habit of doing it weekly. Highly recommend

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Desiccant Bag
text: Does the job but the noise woke my partner up. The motor on this PETLIBRO is noticeably loud when it dispenses. We keep it in the hallway and it woke my partner up at the 6am feed for the first week until we moved it further away. Also the display light is quite bright in a dark room. On the plus side, the portions seem accurate and setup was simple enough. Middling product — does what it says, just noisily

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L with LCD Screen
text: Battery backup is a complete myth. We had a brief power cut last month — couldn't have been longer than two hours — and when power came back the feeder had completely reset. Every single schedule wiped. The listing specifically advertises battery backup to preserve settings during outages. Put batteries in before we even set it up, so they were definitely installed. Raised this with the seller and got a copy-paste response about checking battery orientation. Absolutely useless. The whole point of backup batteries is for exactly this scenario and they failed entirely. One star

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Automatic Cat Feeder Stainless Steel
text: Great capacity, minor app grumbles. The hopper on this feeder is enormous — I fill it once a week for my two Bengals and have plenty left over. Build quality feels solid and the stainless steel bowl is a lovely touch, much easier to keep hygienic than plastic. My only grumble is the companion app, which crashed on first launch and needed a full reinstall before it would connect. Once it was working though, scheduling meals from my phone is genuinely convenient. Would buy again

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder Programmable 5 Meals
text: Portion sizes wildly inconsistent. I bought this specifically to help manage my older cat's weight — she needs precise meals to keep on top of her kidney diet. This feeder dispenses anywhere between 15g and 28g when set to the same portion level. I weighed ten consecutive meals out of curiosity and the variation is massive. For a healthy cat it probably doesn't matter much, but for a cat on a vet-prescribed diet it's genuinely problematic. Switching back to the SureFeed microchip feeder which, while not timed, at least keeps the food fresh and only opens for the correct cat

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with App Control
text: Brilliant. Has transformed our mornings.. No more 4:30am wake-up calls from our tabby. Set the first meal for 6am and he now sits patiently by the feeder rather than sitting on my face. The PETLIBRO app is genuinely easy to use, connected first time, and I can adjust meals from wherever I am. We've been using it for four months and haven't had a single jam or missed feed. Proper brilliant bit of kit

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 3L Programmable
text: Stopped working after five weeks. Motor gave out completely after five weeks. Just makes a grinding noise now and dispenses nothing. Contacted Amazon and got a replacement — the replacement lasted four weeks before doing exactly the same thing. Both times using the same dry kibble, nothing out of the ordinary. Clearly a fundamental design flaw with the rotor mechanism. Do not bother

product_name: Cat Mate C300 Automatic Dry Food Pet Feeder
text: Decent enough but cleaning is a faff. The actual feeding function works well and my cat has taken to it fine. However, getting it properly clean is a real faff. The rotor mechanism and the chamber underneath collect stale kibble dust and you need a small brush to get into all the corners — nothing in the box to help with that. The hopper lid also doesn't come fully apart, so there are spots you simply can't reach properly. I give it three stars because it works, but manufacturers really need to think about hygiene when designing these things

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Voice Recorder
text: Really reliable after a shaky start. Had one food jam in the first week but switched to slightly smaller kibble and haven't had a problem since. Would be nice if the manual made clearer which kibble sizes are compatible — lesson learned. Now running four scheduled meals daily for three months without issue. The voice recording feature where you can record yourself calling your cat to the feeder is a sweet touch and actually works — our cat genuinely responds to my recorded voice. Solid four stars

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 6L Wifi App Control
text: App demanded too many permissions and crashed repeatedly. I'm not particularly tech-averse but the app for this feeder is genuinely dreadful. It requested access to my location, contacts, and camera before I could even create an account — why does a cat feeder need my contacts? Then it crashed three times during setup. Eventually got it connected after about 45 minutes but it lost the connection overnight and I had to pair it again the next morning. The physical feeder itself seems fine but I bought the wifi model specifically for remote access and the app makes that essentially unusable. Disappointing

product_name: SureFeed Microchip Pet Feeder
text: SureFeed is worth every penny. We have two cats — one greedy, one timid — and the SureFeed microchip feeder has been an absolute godsend. Fatty can't steal from the other bowl any more and our shy one actually eats properly now. Yes it's expensive compared to basic feeders, but when you're spending money on prescription food for one cat you need it going to the right animal. Absolutely worth it. Has been running faultlessly for eight months

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder Programmable LCD Display
text: Woke me up every night with error beeping. Returned after a week. The feeder would emit a series of loud beeps at random times during the night — always between 2am and 4am — showing an error code that isn't in the manual. Emailed the company and got a response six days later suggesting I factory reset it. Did that. Same problem every night. The cat was fine with it, I was not. Dreadful

product_name: Cat Mate C100 Automatic Pet Feeder
text: Good value, does exactly what it says. Bought this as a backup to our main SureFeed for when we're away overnight. For the price it's genuinely impressive — solid plastic, straightforward to programme, and holds enough for a couple of days. Wouldn't rely on it long term as a primary feeder but for occasional use it's brilliant value. Setup took about ten minutes including reading the instructions properly

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder with Desiccant
text: Kibble gets damp and clumps inside the hopper. Three weeks of use and I opened the hopper to refill it to find the kibble at the bottom completely clumped together from moisture. The desiccant bag included was already saturated and the seal on the lid isn't tight enough to keep humidity out. We live in Scotland so it's not like the air is tropical, but apparently it's damp enough to ruin the food. Replaceable desiccant bags are sold separately at a daft price. Design oversight that should have been sorted before selling the product

product_name: PETLIBRO Granary Wifi Automatic Cat Feeder
text: My anxious cat actually seems calmer. Didn't expect this but since getting the automatic feeder my rescue cat seems noticeably less anxious around mealtimes. The vet suggested that cats can develop stress when they associate food provision with their owner — removing me from the equation apparently helps some cats feel more in control. Whether that's true I don't know but he's definitely more relaxed and eating better. Easy to set up, quiet enough to keep in the bedroom hallway, and the app works perfectly on my Android. Brilliant purchase

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 4L Single Bowl
text: Fine for one cat, struggles with two. We use this for two cats who eat at the same time. The single bowl causes squabbles because one cat dominates it entirely. That's probably user error for not buying two separate units, but the listing does say suitable for multiple cats which is misleading. The feeder itself works as described — portions are roughly accurate and it hasn't jammed in two months — but the single bowl design means one of our cats consistently gets less than her share

product_name: Automatic Pet Feeder 3L Programmable Timer
text: Whole unit snapped apart when I tried to clean it. Followed the cleaning instructions, tried to separate the hopper from the base unit as directed, and the clip mechanism snapped clean off. Feeder is now unusable because the two halves won't stay together. Bought it five weeks ago so I'm within return window thankfully, but what a shocking build quality. The plastic is incredibly thin and brittle. Absolute waste of twenty-five quid

product_name: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder 4L
text: Does the night feeds so I finally get some sleep. Our cat used to wake us between 3am and 5am without fail every single morning. Set the PETLIBRO to dispense a small portion at 3am and another at 5am and we've had uninterrupted sleep for two months. Revolutionary honestly. Slight grumble that the power cable is quite short and positioning was tricky, but nothing a small extension lead didn't solve. The portion sizes are consistent and the build feels sturdy. Really pleased with it
